howto.goal: Get five or more of your stones in an unbroken line — across, down, or diagonally.
howto.setup: A 15 by 15 board. White moves first.

sections.title: Placing
sections.text: Click an empty point to place a stone. Stones never move or come off.

sections.title: Five in a row
sections.text: Five or more touching stones in a straight line wins immediately.

sections.title: Open threes
sections.text: Three in a row with both ends open is very hard to stop — build those first.

controls: Click an empty point to place a stone.
The ringed point is where this lesson wants you.
Watch for the computer's open three and block one end.

frames.say: Three in a row, both ends open.

demo.intro: A short computer game: white builds a line and black has to answer it.

lines.say: White extends the other way — the line now has one open end.

demo.outro: A three with an open end threatens four — block it before it becomes five.

steps.say: Click the centre point for your first stone.
Build a line of three with both ends open.
Block the computer's open three before it becomes four.
Five in a row ends the game — keep counting.
